Annexure – I (Scope of Work & Technical Details) Scope of Work & Technical Details: - Scope of Work: Retrofit of Secondary Brake of 600 BHP 4# Shaft Incline Winder with Fail-Safe El ectro Hydraulic Disc Brake. • Design and detailed engineering of the secondary fail-safe disc brake assembly for the high-

speed coupling shaft. • Supply of one dynamically balanced 800 mm diameter by 30 mm thick brake disc flange wit h 40 mm mounting posts. • Supply of a heavy-duty spring-applied, hydraulically released fail-safe disc brake caliper set c omplete with sintered pads and safety limit switches. • Supply of a dedicated 5.0 HP hydraulic power unit with 20 LPM pump, directional control valv e, emergency drain valve, and manual hand pump. • Supply of a local electrical solenoid control panel and interface for integration with the winde r PLC safety circuits. • Dismantling of the existing obsolete thruster brake assembly. • Erection, alignment, piping, and mechanical installation of the new brake disc, posts, and cal iper units. • Interfacing, electrical wiring, and integration into the winder emergency-stop and drive interl ock loop. • Site testing, dynamic deceleration trials from 2.5 m/s man-riding speed, commissioning, and final handover. Delivery schedule: Complete supply of all the items within 16 weeks from the date of placemen t of order, Installation and commissioning job within 14 days with winder shutdown. Payment schedule: 30 days credit, after successfully supply, installation testing, trail run. Guarantee: 12 months from the date of commissioning with any manufacturing defects, malfunc tioning of the system. Submission of detail drawing & technical catalogue: Party has to submit all the details like drawings, catalogue etc. for onward submission/intimation to DGMS. Party is also required to carry out any modification/alteration of the system as per suggestion by DGMS. Important Note: (1) Only Payment term 30 days credit, as per payment schedule. (2) Delivery Period: Immediately but within 126 days from the date of receipt of PO. (3) Inspection of materials at our stores will be final. (4) Offer must be submitted FOR destination, delivery of materials at our Mosabani Mines Store, Mosabani basis. Supplier shall arrange transporter and deliver materials as freight paid basis . (5) Delivery Address: Store-in-Charge, Hindustan Copper Limited, Indian Copper Complex, Mo saboni Mines Stores, Post: Mosaboni, Distt. East Singhbhum, Jharkhand – 832104.
